The '''Stone Prison''' was a secret [[Prison/Legends|prison]] located deep underground beneath the [[Royal Manse]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Doan]]. It contained a several levels and a maze of corridors, making it nearly impossible to escape. It also had a control room from which a self-destruct order could be initiated, which then would detonate a series of explosives in a way that would collapse the entire prison. A code known only to the royal family could start the detonation sequence.<ref name="DOE" />

By the [[Time/Legends|time]] following the [[New Sith Wars]], the [[Doan Royal House|Doan Royal Family]] had discontinued its use. However, [[Prince/Legends|Prince]] [[Gerran]] knew the code for the prison's self-destruction, and shared it with his wife, Princess [[Serra]]. Following the [[Assassin/Legends|assassination]] of Gerran and the resulting [[Massacre on Doan|massacre]] of several [[mining caste]] leaders and [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Medd Tandar]], Serra traveled to the [[Jedi Temple/Legends|Jedi Temple]] on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]], where she learned that her father, [[Caleb]], had been [[Confrontation on Ambria|killed]] [[990 BBY|ten years previously]] by a [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]]. Mistakenly believing the Sith Lord to be [[Darth Bane/Legends|Darth Bane]], she hired [[Darth Cognus|the Huntress]] to [[Skirmish in Darth Bane's mansion|capture]] Bane.<ref name="DOE" />

Serra then secretly reopened the Stone Prison and put Bane inside, where she kept him incapacitated and [[Torture/Legends|tortured]] him through the use of various injections. She interrogated him there, but he insisted that he did not kill Caleb. Serra's [[Bodyguard/Legends|bodyguard]], [[Lucia (soldier)|Lucia]]&mdash;who had served under Bane as a member of the [[Gloom Walkers]] during the [[New Sith Wars]]&mdash;was shocked by Serra's vengefulness. Remembering the many times that Bane had saved the lives of the Gloom Walkers during the war, she decided to repay Bane by freeing him. However, after escaping, Bane began to hunt down Serra, with the intent of killing her. Lucia confronted him, but Bane's [[Sith apprentice/Legends|apprentice]], [[Darth Zannah/Legends|Darth Zannah]], arrived in the prison and attacked them, instantly [[Death/Legends|killing]] Lucia.<ref name="DOE" />

In addition to Zannah's arrival, the [[Dark Jedi/Legends|Dark Jedi]] [[Set Harth]] arrived as Zannah's apprentice. However, he later discovered the [[Sith holocron/Legends|Sith holocron]] of [[Darth Andeddu]], and left her in order to retrieve it from Serra's office. As Zannah and Bane engaged in a [[Duel on Doan|duel]] for the title of [[Dark Lord of the Sith/Legends|Dark Lord of the Sith]], Serra found her dead friend and realized that her vengeance had been a mistake. The Princess finally decided to collapse the prison in an attempt to kill the two Sith. She then fled Doan, knowing that the prison's collapse would be felt in the Royal Manse. However, Bane, Zannah, Set, and the Huntress all escaped before the prison's collapse, and the Huntress&mdash;taking the name [[Darth/Legends|Darth]] Cognus&mdash;submitted herself to Bane's teachings. In the [[Stalker (shuttle)|''Stalker'']], Cognus' [[Shuttle/Legends|shuttle]], the two [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] tracked Serra to [[Ambria/Legends|Ambria]], where Cognus killed the Princess. In the shuttle he used to escape, Set began training with his newly acquired holocron, intending to learn the secret of [[essence transfer]] in order to prolong his life.<ref name="DOE" />
